diagnosis: Customer on standard support tier with 90-day audit log retention per kb-0013. They need 12 months (365 days) which requires premium tier's 400-day retention. No entitlement workaround available.
reply: On your current plan, audit log entries are retained for 90 days. Export is available through the audit endpoint as NDJSON for any entries within that retention window. If you need a longer retention period, upgrading to premium would extend audit log retention to 400 days. I can connect you with the team that handles plan changes if you'd like to explore that option.
